name: io.github.chrischall/sixflags-mcp
description: Six Flags MCP for Claude — live wait times, park hours, shows, and day planning

environmentVariables.name: SIXFLAGS_HOME_PARK
environmentVariables.description: Default park for tools that don't name one. A park name, themeparks.wiki slug, or park id. Defaults to Carowinds.

environmentVariables.name: SIXFLAGS_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in ms. Defaults to 15000.

environmentVariables.name: SIXFLAGS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: User-Agent sent to themeparks.wiki. Defaults to sixflags-mcp (+https://github.com/chrischall/sixflags-mcp).
